answer: The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 124 to 269 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the pulse identity is graded at all. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the whisper audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, as the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the cipher band is published for each class. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
